description: Full-precision PermutationalLut reference. Same architecture as exp018 (E=64, H=6, d_qk=32, d_v=16, separate Q/K, sum-mode pos_emb 64) but every BitPermutationLUT replaced with PermutationalLut(smooth_mode=True, n_alternatives=1, soft_mode='rational', aggregation='matmul', return_dominance=True, scrambled pair_mode). Weights become regular fp32 nn.Parameters → all params managed by AdamW (no separate bit-LUT optimizer). DominanceCanonicalize after each LUT preserves the no-magnitude-leak rank-flow property. Tests the architecture's true potential without 1-bit quantization noise. Reference: exp018 step 8000 = 1.8038 (16k schedule), exp007 step 8000 = 1.8356 (8k schedule, H=4).
